title: Man of Steel #4 DC 1986 Lex Luthor Strikes John Byrne Dick Giordano Superman
conditionDescription: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Man of Steel #4 (of 6) (November 1986), DC Comics - "Lex Luthor Strikes!" John Byrne's post-Crisis Superman reboot; Lex Luthor's first modern-era appearance as a corporate tycoon. By John Byrne and Dick Giordano. Direct edition, 75 cent cover price.

Back cover: Starburst & Skittles Sportacular ad.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
